name: feature-velocity
title: Feature Velocity Grid
description: A black feature grid under an oversized uppercase headline: three cards with icon tiles and short labels, each lighting up with its own colour wash when hovered.
use: A dark technical product page needs three headline capabilities that react to the pointer.
avoid: Cards are fixed in the source, and the tiny grey labels fail contrast on dark screens.
a11y: The colour reveal exists only on hover, so touch users never see it, and the icons are unlabelled. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black section with a faint diagonal pinstripe texture fading downward. An enormous white uppercase headline sits left of a tiny grey mono paragraph, above three dark rounded cards each with a small pale icon tile, a faint label and a bold uppercase title.
behaves: Hovering a card washes it with a soft diagonal colour tint, violet for the first, green for the second, and dims its outline toward black. The tint fades out again when the pointer leaves.
customise: Card titles, labels, icons and tint colours are inline in the map; spacing and the stripe backdrop are section classes.
weight: light: Three static cards with a CSS opacity fade on hover.
